digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler exit-code translation and bridge/legacy adapter
propositions: Canonical preview/sync operations must exit only 0/1/2 (success, failure, invalid invocation) while benign dispositions map to 0
Legacy reconcile CLI and direct-engine routes must retain historical 3/4/75 exit codes (another pass, phase gate, reschedule) with original messages and defaults for backward compatibility
One typed disposition representation must be consumed by both canonical and legacy adapters with separate translation boundaries at the outer numeric adapter
Production workflows, systemd units, Jenkins jobs, and scripts using legacy 3/4/75 codes must continue functioning without modification under rolling migration
Both canonical and legacy code paths must preserve repository effects, mutation semantics, and paused-state commit-skip behavior without introducing retry or composed-write contention
